name: note_operations
description: add_note_to_chord, add_rest, delete_note all work. add_tie is #24673-broken: cmd('tie') is isNotationPage-gated and no-ops in form-extension context (even with a matching next note), so it returns an honest error.

steps.prompt: Add a quarter note C4 at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1.
Add E4 to the chord at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1 (add to existing chord).
Add a quarter rest at measure 1 beat 2 staff 1.
Add a tie to the note at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1.
Delete the note at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1 pitch C4.
